Nadia: Heads-up - Pulsar (prospect) wants Private deployment of Alembic-70B (customer-tuned variant). Key asks: KV cache support, Q4 quant path, tokenizer parity, and KMS integration. Need quick compatibility check.
Jorge: Do we have their model bundle? sales said they'd drop a tar with model.bin + tokenizer.json. Need to know vocab_size and whether tokenizer adds ~special tokens.
Nadia: Sales will upload after the call. They emphasized latency targets ~80ms P95 for 64 tokens and enterprise KMS. Also asked for a pricing delta for Dedicated vs Private.
Priya: Notes: Private supports external KMS but we need KMS key ARN + role trust policy. For tokenizer differences we can either remap or ship a tokenizer shim; remap impacts cache alignment.
Jorge: Quick local checks I'll run tomorrow: 1) print config (vocab_size, hidden_size) 2) run tokenizer sample on customer vocab 3) perf probe for Q4 (128 tokens) on a single A100 to compare tok/sec. Snippet I'll use:
```
python - <<EOF
from transformers import AutoConfig, AutoTokenizer
c = AutoConfig.from_pretrained('/tmp/alembic')
print('vocab', c.vocab_size)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/tmp/alembic')
print(tok.encode('Hello world')[:10])
EOF
```
Priya: I'll own KMS checklist + KV cache compatibility doc. If their kv layout uses nonstandard segment offsets we'll need a small shim; it could reduce prefix-hit rate.
Nadia: Timeline: sales wants an ops-ready note + ballpark pricing by EOD Thursday. Can we target Wed for the compatibility scan?
Jorge: I'll run the probe Tuesday evening and post results. Will mention expected mitigations (token remap, fallback to unsharded KV).
Priya: I'll draft the KMS steps and list required customer artifacts (key ARN, IAM role, TLS certs if any) and post as a checklist.
deploy-bot: Created ticket DL-99821 to track Alembic-70B compatibility work (assignee: Jorge). https://projects.redwood.ai/DL-99821
Nadia: Great. After results we'll produce a 1-page SOW addendum with tech risks + pricing delta (Private premium + engineering onboarding days). :thumbsup:
